<thought>To find the desired template, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a reaction that breaks a phosphonate (C‑P) and a C‑O bond and forms a C‑C double bond, resulting in an aliphatic carboxylic acid and an alkene. I will use a simple representative product of a Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons reaction, acrylic acid (C=CC(=O)O), as the target molecule for the search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["phosphonate"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene", "carboxylic_acid"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (1.0->2.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
